block.goal: Extract the cohesive parameter-map storage and query responsibilities from JobParameters while preserving its existing public API and value-object behavior.

ops.details: Extract the parameters field and its cohesive map-oriented behavior into JobParametersStore. Move the implementation responsibilities for getParameter(String), getParameters(), getIdentifyingParameters(), and isEmpty() into the extracted class. Keep JobParameters as the public facade, delegating these methods to JobParametersStore so existing callers and the typed-accessor API remain unchanged. Preserve the defensive copying, unmodifiable-map results, identifying-parameter filtering, and parameter-map access required by equals(Object), hashCode(), toString(), and JobParametersTypedAccessors.

package org.springframework.batch.item.file.transform;

/**

 *
 * @author Dave Syer
 * @author Mahmoud Ben Hassine

 */
public interface FieldExtractor<T> {

	/**
	 * @param item the object that contains the information to be extracted.
	 * @return an array containing item's parts

	Object[] extract(T item);

}

A bit like the role played by {@link ResultSet} * in JDBC, clients will know the name or position of strongly typed fields that they want * to extract. * * @author Dave Syer * */ public interface FieldSet { /** * Accessor for the names of the fields. * @return the names * @throws IllegalStateException if the names are not defined */ String[] getNames();
